experiments.hypothesis: Plus Jakarta Sans is the safer global source candidate than the historical DM Sans baseline and must pass staging/native/render evidence before production approval.
experiments.scope: Validate the Step17E Plus Jakarta Sans source candidate across launch locales; retain DM Sans only as historical comparison evidence, not a production fallback.
experiments.successMetric: No glyph fallback; no material CLS/layout regression; human/native premium review equal or better.
experiments.premiumBenchmarkImpact: Must preserve or improve CardeLume premium/WOW perception and multilingual typography naturalness.

experiments.hypothesis: Original procedural typography/personalization-led concepts outperform generic legacy motifs on premium/WOW, originality and anti-sameness.
experiments.scope: Benchmark all 12 implemented original procedural POCs against the retained/rework legacy families; do not promote generic or culturally reductive legacy motifs by default.
experiments.successMetric: Higher human Premium Art Direction/Originality/WOW with no render, locale, IP or concentration regression.
experiments.premiumBenchmarkImpact: Must exceed or match launch floors and improve creative diversity without template quotas.
